scope: seven-rider S F1 and additional nonduplicated S prelim, 2023-2026H1
decision_features: market odds + source predicted lines + market volume only; results used for grading only

metric_definition.cross_market_xEV: normalized trifecta-set implied probability multiplied by final trio odds
metric_definition.line_shape: sorted length of published predicted lines; no outcome-dependent allocation
metric_definition.ticket_shape: number of distinct published predicted line IDs in unordered 3-person set
metric_definition.single_race_rule: choose max cross_market_xEV, optional rank<=10 filter, before reading winner
metric_definition.observation: Every selector includes at most one ticket per race, 100 yen equally weighted
metric_definition.caveat: No previous 15min T-15 observations here, no untouched prospective test, xEV bins explored ex post
